What the camera signal actually contains

120 seconds of Kaggle subject 1, starting at video time 20 seconds. All traces below are numeric signals; no face images are embedded. This is a diagnostic experiment, not held-out physiological validation.

Development test, not ECG validation. Reference is 64 Hz Empatica wrist PPG. The visible start marker and recording duration support tags 2–3. End-marker discrepancy is about 0.34 s over seven minutes; no drift correction or waveform-fitted alignment is applied. Sparse IBI references retain their gaps.

Classical baselines use offline zero-phase filtering and overlapping 8-second windows. Production runs use streaming gates and their native readout cadence; rows are not a controlled latency comparison. Removing region agreement and widening the mask are diagnostic experiments, not released fixes.

Each trace is centered and scaled independently within the selected window. Time is unchanged: no alignment fitting, time warping or beat-spacing regularization. Gaps in committed waveforms remain gaps.
